title: Commit bundle
description: Input for openteams/cog-release-notes. PROPOSED contract: this file is what the manifest would reference as context.input_schema — shipped here as a workbench overlay so the frozen forge package stays untouched.

repository.description: Repository name or credential-sanitized remote URL

from_ref.description: Older ref (exclusive end of the range)

audience.description: Who the notes are written for

notes.description: Bundle caveats (e.g. truncations) — the model sees these too

commits.description: Commits in the range, full 40-char ids. Build one with the Cog's own `pixi run bundle`, load an example as a template, or edit JSON directly.
